E0962

`reject` runs only inside a marker's `expand` template.

What

`reject` runs only inside a marker's `expand` template.

Why

`reject(value)` raises a diagnostic at a marker's use site while the compiler expands the marker; ordinary code has no use site to report at, so the call has nothing to run.

Fix

Move the check into a marker's `expand: fn(self, target: Target)` body, or return an error value from this function instead.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0962: tests/ui/marker_declarations/reject_outside_a_marker_template.stderr.
